# Security policy

## Supported versions

Aiden is pre-release. Security fixes target the current development branch. Once beta releases begin, only the latest published beta will receive fixes.

## Report a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/opheleon/aiden-preview/security/advisories/new). Include the affected version, impact, and a minimal reproduction using synthetic data. Keep exploit details out of public issues and Slack channels; never attach credentials or private source, prompts, or reports.

If private reporting is unavailable, use the [support channel](SUPPORT.md) to request a private maintainer contact without disclosing vulnerability details. Maintainers will coordinate disclosure with the reporter after a fix is available.

## Security boundaries

See the [architecture guide](../docs/architecture.md#trust-boundaries) for process, tool, and data boundaries, and [dependency security](../docs/dependency-security.md) for dependency policy and reviewed exceptions.
